messages: devon: Heads-up: CI linkcheck failed after the new slugify update. seeing broken anchors on /guides/migrate and /sdk/python/examples maria: ugh. which PR? and which anchors are 404ing? devon: PR #2398 (slugify bump). report shows fragments: /guides/migrate#runtime-config and /sdk/python/examples#code-sample-embed kevin: i think this is the nonbreaking-hyphen normalization (we hit this with emoji anchors before). some header ids are being generated with U+2011 instead of plain `-`. olga: options: 1) add explicit MDX ids (e.g. `### Runtime config {#runtime-config}`), 2) post-process generated HTML to insert ASCII-id aliases, or 3) whitelist these fragments in linkcheck for a short window. maria: i prefer explicit MDX ids so source is authoritative. i'll prepare a tiny PR patching the two pages and add linkcheck fixture tests. devon: remember docs live in both docusaurus and mkdocs trees for some pages; if content is duplicated patch both. kevin: note: some docs include literal fragment links inside code blocks. those won't auto-update if we change slug rules. maybe use path-only links in examples and call out stable ids in a comment. maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2769 — added `{#runtime-config}` to guides/migrate.md and `{#code-sample-embed}` to sdk/python/examples.md, plus a couple of linkcheck fixtures. linkcheck-bot: Linkcheck started for PR #2769 linkcheck-bot: FAILURE: 2 broken fragments: - /guides/migrate#runtime-config -> fragment not found - /sdk/python/examples#code-sample-embed -> fragment not found kevin: if explicit ids are still being rewritten to the nonbreaking hyphen variant during the build, they won't match. check the built HTML to see final ids. maria: deploy-bot, can you spin a preview so i can inspect generated markup? deploy-bot: preview ready: https://deploy-preview-2769--redwood-docs.netlify.app (indexing...) maria: inspected built HTML — my `{#runtime-config}` became `runtime‑config` (nonbreaking hyphen). linkcheck expects `runtime-config`. olga: quick mitigation: i can add a tiny post-build script that scans generated HTML and injects legacy ASCII anchor aliases for affected headings. prototype sketch below: ``` // scripts/anchor-alias-injector.js (sketch) const fs = require('fs'); const cheerio = require('cheerio'); // for each html file, if heading id contains U+2011, add an before it ``` maria: if injector can run only on preview pipeline we can get green previews and merge. long-term we should fix slugify ordering. devon: agree. plan: olga lands injector on preview only, kevin files infra ticket to reorder processors, and we add 14-day linkcheck exceptions for the two fragments to avoid flaky CI. kevin: created infra ticket INFRA-1294 to move remark-id plugin after slugify. i'll add unit tests for id normalization. olga: pushed injector prototype and updated preview pipeline in my fork. PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2769 (includes injector run for previews). linkcheck-bot: Rerun linkcheck on preview (with injector) -> PASS maria: Preview passes now. i'll merge the explicit-id + injector change and follow up to remove injector after INFRA-1294. also adding a note in the migration guide about the slugify change. devon: follow-ups: - audit frequently-linked pages for literal fragment links - create 2-week reminder to remove temporary exceptions/injector - coord with eng-runtime if any runtime docs reference frag ids kevin: i'll run the top-20 audit and open PRs for literal links. maria: merged; thanks folks. tagging @eng-runtime for awareness. :shipit: devon: thanks all :thumbsup:
